prior_importants.description: The test "reads the setting the project gives" calls `workerSandboxOn` with `workerSandbox: true` and expects `true`, but it never fakes `process.platform`. On any host that is not macOS, `workerSandboxOn` throws "refused outside macOS", so the test fails. That includes Linux hosts where pup gates itself under `PUP_SANDBOX=vm`.

process_issues.description: Round 7 budget: the delta is the one-line it.runIf guard in src/core/project-config-config.test.ts applying the prior important's suggestion. Only correctness ran; security (no trust boundary touched), guards (no non-test source changed), workflow-safety (no workflow change) and spec (no spec source) were gated off, and conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability are skipped from round 4 on per §4. No consolidator was spawned because there were no findings to group.
